title: AKS cluster (small, Entra ID RBAC, private API)
description: A small Azure Kubernetes Service cluster: private API server, Entra ID sign-in with Azure RBAC, local accounts disabled, workload identity, Azure Policy add-on, Azure CNI Overlay with Cilium network policy, automatic patch upgrades.
security_defaults: Private API server (no public Kubernetes endpoint)
Entra ID authentication + Azure RBAC; local (certificate) accounts disabled
Workload identity (OIDC) enabled; Azure Policy add-on enabled
Automatic patch and node-image upgrades; Cilium network policy

admin_group_object_ids.description: Entra group object IDs whose members are cluster administrators.

private_cluster.description: Private API server. If false, restrict access with authorized_ip_ranges.

authorized_ip_ranges.description: Public clusters only: CIDR ranges allowed to reach the API server.

kubernetes_version.description: Kubernetes version such as 1.31 (omit for the regional default).

sku_tier.description: Standard adds the financially backed uptime SLA; use it for production.

node_vm_size.description: VM size of the system node pool.

node_subnet_id.description: Existing subnet for the nodes (omit to let AKS create its own network). Cannot be changed later.

outputs.oidc_issuer_url: OIDC issuer for workload identity federation
outputs.node_resource_group: Resource group AKS manages for nodes

notes: AKS creates and manages a second resource group for its nodes (node_resource_group), including a public IP for outbound traffic that is not part of this plan.
With node_subnet_id, the cluster identity needs Network Contributor on that subnet; grant it separately - the agent's identity cannot assign roles.
A private cluster is reachable only from its network (or az aks command invoke).
